caller_context.scope: extent, instruction boundaries, direct edge and source association only; no behavioral bind

hits.boundary_validation: complete strict linear decode from unique caller FDE start; all local branch targets align

caller_scan.method: all byte positions, signed little-endian rel32, then instruction-boundary validation

padding.classification: INT3 fill outside the return-closed FDE

semantics.seam_equality: return first record of the wrapped second span immediately
semantics.span_search: last key <= sought (or first record); equal returns found, otherwise insertion position

source_association.claim: source-associated caller; original leaf symbol and Rust type remain unknown
